steps.input:
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    fours = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 4]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 6]
    if not fours or not sixes:
        return out
    top = min(r for r, c in fours)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in fours)
    left = min(c for r, c in fours)
    right = max(c for r, c in fours)
    marker_top = min(r for r, c in sixes)
    marker_bottom = max(r for r, c in sixes)
    marker_left = min(c for r, c in sixes)
    marker_right = max(c for r, c in sixes)
    height = bottom - top + 1
    width = right - left + 1
    vertical_copy = (marker_right - marker_left + 1) > (marker_bottom - marker_top + 1)
    for r, row in enumerate(out):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value == 6:
                out[r][c] = 0
    if vertical_copy:
        marker_below = (marker_top + marker_bottom) > (top + bottom)
        away = -1 if marker_below else 1
        up_fits = top >= height
        down_fits = bottom + height < len(out)
        direction = away if (up_fits if away == -1 else down_fits) else -away
        for r, c in fours:
            target_r = (top + 2 * height - 1 - r) if direction == 1 else (2 * top - 1 - r)
            if 0 <= target_r < len(out):
                out[target_r][c] = 4
    else:
        marker_rightward = (marker_left + marker_right) > (left + right)
        away = -1 if marker_rightward else 1
        left_fits = left >= width
        right_fits = right + width < len(out[0])
        direction = away if (left_fits if away == -1 else right_fits) else -away
        for r, c in fours:
            target_c = (2 * right + 1 - c) if direction == 1 else (2 * left - 1 - c)
            if 0 <= target_c < len(out[0]):
                out[r][target_c] = 4
    return out
'''
